lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
prepared_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)

phases.phase: Research and solution design (Foundry agents, Entra Agent ID, API Management MCP, Container Apps, Dataverse, pricing)
phases.assumptions: Microsoft Learn research notes with sources for every exercise area; region, model and tier decisions recorded in BUILD-NOTES.md.

phases.phase: MCP server (12 tools, policy, telemetry, tests, Dockerfile, client and deploy scripts)
phases.assumptions: 21 automated tests pass against the fixture backend; Dataverse calls verified against a mock. Not yet run against a live Dataverse environment.

phases.phase: Seed data generator and loader (customers, contacts, articles, technicians, tickets, notes, business-hours SLA)
phases.assumptions: Deterministic seed; loader verified against a mock Dataverse Web API (all counts match).

phases.phase: Provisioning automation (ARM template, userData bootstrap, logon task, Dataverse schema and app, developer environment, agent, gateway)
phases.assumptions: Static checks pass; first live deployment still to run. Developer environment creation as the team user and application user creation are the riskiest steps.

phases.phase: Governance quartet (ARM policy, custom RBAC, usage policy) and masterdoc
phases.assumptions: Allow-list mirrors deploy-01.json resource types and SKUs.

phases.phase: Lab guide content (getting started, five exercises, README, facilitator guide with answer keys)
phases.assumptions: Written to the cloudlabs-step-by-step profile; portal labels taken from Microsoft Learn and flagged where the docs are thin.

phases.phase: Validation scripts (9 PowerShellV2 checks) and registration checklist
phases.assumptions: Checks read ARM, AI Search and Log Analytics with the CloudLabs service principal; GUIDs are minted at registration.
Captured during the pilot walk-through; 6 getting-started shots reused from the standard CloudLabs set.

phases.phase: Pilot deployment, end-to-end test and fixes
phases.assumptions: One full walk-through plus fixes for the pilot checklist items in setup/README.md (portal label drift, identity behavior, log fields).

phases.phase: Platform onboarding (template library, blob uploads, template configuration, validation registration, licence assignment)

phases.assumptions: Gateway app registration, Power Platform settings, quota check, a Microsoft licensing answer on shared team accounts, and confirming Temporary Access Pass sign-in for attendees plus password sign-in to Power Platform for provisioning in the TAP tenant.

risks.risk: In the TAP tenant, AzureAdUserPassword holds a Temporary Access Pass, so provisioning can't sign the team account in to Power Platform and Dataverse without a browser
risks.impact: Developer environment, schema, security and seed steps fail; Azure Resource Manager steps are unaffected (they run as the provisioning managed identity)
risks.mitigation: Settle before the pilot: a password valid during provisioning, or a Power Platform service principal that creates the environment for the team account (setup/README.md section 1)

risks.risk: Creating a Power Platform developer environment as each team account fails or is restricted in the lab tenant
risks.impact: No Dataverse environment, so no Service Desk app or seed data
risks.mitigation: Pilot first; fallback is an admin-created environment per team with the team account as System Administrator

risks.risk: Shared team accounts on the Developer Plan are judged multiplexing
risks.mitigation: Get written confirmation from Microsoft licensing, or give every attendee an account

risks.risk: Foundry portal labels for adding MCP tools change before delivery
risks.impact: Learners can't follow Exercise 3 Task 2 as written
risks.mitigation: Fallback script Update-AgentDefinition.ps1 -Tools; re-check labels in the pilot

risks.risk: API Management MCP log SessionId is empty and CorrelationId differs from the server's correlation ID
risks.impact: Exercise 3 and 5 trace steps read differently
risks.mitigation: Guide already covers an empty SessionId; verify the CorrelationId join in the pilot

risks.risk: Model quota below 30K TPM per team in Sweden Central
risks.mitigation: Check the quota tier before the event; reduce capacity per team if needed

risks.impact: ACR Tasks paused: provisioning and redeploy exercises fail
